lessons: watchdog-activation: state the drain notification contract. Either _drain builds the config.notify SubprocessNotifications transport and runs NotificationReconciler.reconcile at startup and after each dispatch, or drain trips stay status-only and the drain criterion says so.
watchdog-activation: name the journal signal the binding appends on a soft trip and on stuck. Give its kind and its body fields: ticket, spiral, run_seq.
watchdog-activation: say whether the new signal reuses kind: watchdog. Add the soft and stuck identities to NotificationReconciler._escalations, keyed ticket+spiral+run_seq and ticket+stuck.
watchdog-activation: make the migration of test_notify.py::test_unrelated_signals_and_hold_release_do_not_notify unconditional. Keep a proof that an unrecognized watchdog-kind body does not notify.

watchdog-detector: state the spend unit exactly. The cost basis is an injected USD float, and metered spend sums WatchdogEvent.usd. Token counts are kept but never compared. No token-to-USD conversion.
watchdog-detector: make the flat per-call estimate an explicit injected detector input, in USD.

watchdog-detector: define 'provider without metered usage' mechanically, e.g. an injected per-provider flag or 'no event of the invocation carries usd'. Add an acceptance assertion for a tokens-only stream.
Update tests/test_seeded_phase4_01.py phrase assertions to the revised wording.
Keep everything reviewers accepted: identities, edges, medium/medium tiers, budgets, fences, Context/on-demand partition, sizes, delimiter scanning, registry rows, successor removal, headroom.
Rerun requisition lint on a tree without this diff's files, then rerun both pytest commands.
